MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into between Northgate Analytics Limited ("the
Supplier") and Bramley Foods PLC ("the Customer") and governs all work performed
under any Statement of Work referencing it.

1. TERM AND RENEWAL

The initial term runs for twenty-four months from the Effective Date. Thereafter
the arrangement continues from year to year unless either side gives written
notice of its intention not to continue, delivered no fewer than ninety days
before the anniversary falls due.

2. WHAT THE SUPPLIER UNDERTAKES

The Supplier shall furnish the services described in each Statement of Work with
the care and skill ordinarily expected of a competent practitioner in the field.
Where a deliverable is rejected, the Supplier will put the matter right at its
own expense within fifteen working days of being told what is wrong.

The Supplier warrants that nothing it supplies will infringe the intellectual
property of a third party, and undertakes to defend the Customer against any
claim to the contrary, bearing the cost of doing so.

3. WHAT THE CUSTOMER UNDERTAKES

The Customer shall settle each invoice within thirty days of receipt. Sums left
outstanding beyond that point attract interest at four percent above the Bank of
England base rate, accruing daily until cleared.

The Customer will make available such premises, systems access and personnel as
the Supplier reasonably requires. Delay attributable to the Customer's failure to
do so extends any affected deadline correspondingly.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY

Each party shall keep in confidence everything of a sensitive nature that comes
into its possession by virtue of this arrangement, and shall not divulge it to
anyone outside its own organisation without prior written consent. This
obligation survives termination and continues for five years afterwards.

Information already in the public domain, or independently developed without
reference to the disclosing party's material, falls outside this restriction.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Neither party's aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this
Agreement shall exceed the total sums paid under the relevant Statement of Work
in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

Nothing in this clause operates to exclude liability for death or personal injury
resulting from negligence, nor for fraudulent misrepresentation.

Consequential loss, loss of profit, loss of anticipated savings and damage to
reputation are excluded in all circumstances.

6. BRINGING THE ARRANGEMENT TO AN END

Either party may bring this Agreement to an end immediately by written notice if
the other commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within thirty days of
being asked to do so, or becomes insolvent, or has an administrator appointed.

On termination the Customer shall pay for work properly performed up to that
date, and each party shall return or destroy the other's confidential material.

7. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the parties
submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts.
